limitations: The proposed novelty is conditional on historical bibliographic coverage; possible equivalent rank-generating identities under graph-matroid terminology have not been exhaustively ruled out. No higher-height poset claim, independent audit, or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_integrity: Baclawski 1972 and Xiao 2014 give prior structural descriptions of incidence-algebra derivations; this statement credits those results and claims only the exact rank distribution, Tutte specialization and girth coefficient as the finding. Baclawski has a verified author full-text public upload timestamp 2014-06-07, but the 1972 paper publication has no verified exact day; the date field records first day-resolved public posting among the inspected primary sources and does not redate the original journal work.
scientific_scope: All finite simple bipartite graphs without isolated vertices and all finite fields of prime-power order; ranks refer to each linear derivation operator on its height-two incidence algebra.
title: Derivation-rank polynomials of height-two incidence algebras recover graph girth
